item.title: Version 1.2.1 (10)
item.description: - **Simulator runtime cleanup.** Xcode leaves behind iOS and watchOS runtime images every time it updates, 7 to 19 GB each. MegaCleaner now lists them and pre-selects the empty and superseded ones.

item.title: Version 1.2.0 (9)
item.description: - **MegaCleaner is now free.** All cleaning unlocked, no license, no paywall. - New anonymous daily heartbeat so I can count active installs. No files, paths, or identity collected. See the [privacy policy](https://megacleaner.app/privacy) for what's sent. - Follow me on X for what's coming next: [@nixeton](https://x.com/nixeton).

item.title: Version 1.1.2 (7)
item.description: - New Project Logs scanner finds huge log files hiding in your dev projects (Laravel, Rails, Node, Spring Boot, and more). The multi-GB `laravel.log` no other cleaner sees. - Scan one category at a time. Click Scan on any Dashboard card, or Rescan inside a category, to refresh just that one. - Per-category scan buttons show live progress like "Scanning 42%…" for scanners that report it (Xcode, Node modules). - Menu bar tray keeps the app running in the background. Closing the window now hides it instead of quitting. - Fixed item selection silently breaking after loading cached scan results.

item.title: Version 1.1.1 (6)
item.description: - 10 new scanners: Cloud Storage, Office Apps, Electron Apps, CI/CD & Cloud, Developer Tools, Virtualization, Shell Tools, External Volumes, macOS Installers, and more programming languages - Expanded browser coverage with 8 additional browsers including Brave, Edge, and Vivaldi - Detects old Chromium framework versions inside browser apps (can save 200-800 MB) - ML/AI model cache detection for HuggingFace, PyTorch, and TensorFlow - Frontend build tool caches: Vite, Webpack, Parcel, ESLint, Prettier, and more - JetBrains Toolbox old IDE version detection - Incomplete download detection (.crdownload, .part files) - External volume trash scanning - Sandboxed app and Group Container cache scanning - Smarter orphan detection with running-process awareness - New custom icons for Docker, Android, Terraform, Git, and Electron - Total coverage: 39 scanners, 148 sub-features
